summary: Interactive UX: complete shell completer, full command menu, multi-select cleanup

delivery.outcome: The interactive shell completes every registered command and option from the live click tree, the menu exposes a full command catalog, and cleanup's individual selection accepts a single multi-value input (numbers, ranges, all/none) instead of one confirm per service.
nonGoals: No new dependencies; reuse click and prompt_toolkit already present.
No change to which cleanup operations are offered or their safety gates.

architecture.decision: Derive the shell NestedCompleter from cli.commands and each command's params so completion never drifts; add a 'commands' menu entry printing the full catalog; replace per-service click.confirm in _select_individual_services with a numbered list plus one prompt parsed by a testable _parse_selection helper.
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit; previous menu/completer and confirm-per-service selection return.
